interface.name: value
interface.description: The input value to be checked for changes and edge triggering

interface.name: hasChanged
interface.description: True indicates that the input value has changed

interface.name: hasRisingEdges
interface.description: True indicates that rising edges have occurred in the input value

interface.name: risingBits
interface.description: The bit stream of rising edges, where each bit indicates whether the corresponding input bit has experienced a rising edge (1 for a rising edge, 0 for no rising edge)

interface.name: noOfRisingBits
interface.description: The number of rising edges in the input value

interface.name: hasFallingEdges
interface.description: True indicates that falling edges have occurred in the input value

interface.name: fallingBits
interface.description: The bit stream of falling edges, where each bit indicates whether the corresponding input bit has experienced a falling edge (1 for a falling edge, 0 for no falling edge)

interface.name: noOfFallingBits
interface.description: The number of falling edges in the input value

scan_semantics: At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.
safety_priority: Previous value is updated after calculating both edge masks.
assumptions: The previous DWORD is initialized to DWORD#0. Therefore nonzero bits on the first scan count as rising edges.
Bitwise complement is restricted to 32 bits; counts range from 0 through 32.

formal_properties.explanation: The rising mask identifies only 0-to-1 bits.
The falling mask identifies only 1-to-0 bits.
A bit cannot rise and fall in one scan.
Both counts equal their mask population.
Flags match masks and value changes.
The current value is the next scan history.

atomic_propositions.prev: Ghost pre-scan previous DWORD; initialized to zero.
atomic_propositions.risingBits: End-of-scan mask value & NOT prev, restricted to DWORD width.
atomic_propositions.fallingBits: End-of-scan mask prev & NOT value, restricted to DWORD width.
atomic_propositions.popcount: Number of set bits in the unsigned 32-bit argument.
atomic_propositions.other interface names: Identically named sampled inputs or observed outputs.
